text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C at a loss was painful, but I should reassess it using its outlook and portfolio role—not hold it just to avoid realizing a loss.","My earlier profitable sales of Stock B felt rewarding; I should avoid letting that satisfaction drive premature selling or repeated attempts to time prices.","Recent account swings remind me to check diversification and overall risk, and to size new purchases so I can tolerate further declines."]}
